name: Pizzeria Formaggio
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Formaggio in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Formaggio in Tirol**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol** region. Indulge in our delicious **Pizzen** baked in a traditional wood-fired oven, topped with the finest ingredients from the **Alpen** and beyond.

Try our signature **Kaiserschmarrn** for a sweet, fluffy finish to your meal—just like **Oma** used to make it! Pair it with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Wein** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** for the perfect dining experience.

Located in the heart of **Innsbruck**, we’re just a short stroll from the **Goldenes Dachl** and the lively **Herrenhaus**. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Salami-Pizza**, or a vegetarian delight, our menu has something for everyone.

Come taste the warmth of **Tirol**—one bite at a time!
